entries.55d5b2aef6ee73a6: Starting from the form tie, which was commercialized in 1951, the company has developed construction methods and products together in the fields of temporary construction and formwork, civil engineering and structural equipment. The company is expanding sales of products related to the new 'Single-Tightening Formwork Method', began sales of an improved version of the Serekuto Bēsu column base product for steel-frame construction, and is capturing demand from large-scale projects. In the United States, the company says it captured infrastructure-related construction demand, and that sales of its main products remained firm, supported by stronger prompt-delivery capability following completion of a new warehouse.

entries.dad4d7c367e9c50a: As the final year of the Medium-term Management Plan 'OX-2026 (okabe Transformation 2026)', the company is completing the strategies it set out and aims to leap toward the next stage of growth. The three core pillars of the business strategy are customer-centricity (establishing a structure and implementing initiatives to prioritize solving customers' challenges), putting human capital management into practice and strengthening the management foundation, and further promoting DX. The company's policy is to provide solutions for material issues in Japan and overseas, concentrate management resources, including through a review of its business portfolio, and promote sustainability management. Because the plan's target figures are forward-looking, they are not transcribed here.
